summary: Outputs audio from a Web Render TOP whose browser audio is routed to Audio Web Render CHOPs.
key_concepts: Audio Web Render CHOP plays audio from a web page rendered by a Web Render TOP.
The source Web Render TOP must route its Audio Options to Audio Web Render CHOPs.
The Web Render TOP must also have its Active parameter enabled.
The Web Render TOP parameter selects which browser instance supplies the audio.
Info CHOP diagnostics expose buffer length and dropped buffer counts for unstable web audio.

key_params.name: webrender
key_params.note: Web Render TOP that provides the browser audio

key_params.name: timeslice
key_params.note: Use time-sliced CHOP output for streaming audio

common_gotchas: The source Web Render TOP must have Audio Options routed to Audio Web Render CHOPs.
The Web Render TOP must be active and actually playing page audio.
Use an Info CHOP to inspect buffer length and dropped buffers when audio is unstable.
